metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It supports all four actions, validates GEDCOM 7 structure and payload rules, and reads and writes GEDZIP archives using only Node.js standard libraries.

Verified GEDCOM and GEDZIP round trips, Python ZIP interoperability, structured errors, exit codes, and JavaScript syntax. Run it with `node output/main.js --input request.json --output response.json`.

Encrypted and ZIP64 archives return structured errors; the request format provides no password for encrypted archives.
